intent: Write JUnit 5 + AssertJ tests (reactor-test StepVerifier for Mono/Flux, Mockito for collaborators, no external services, no Thread.sleep) for CorrelationContext. Assert ONLY against the ast_hints method table; at least one given/when/then case per table method and per branch. Unit contract: Shared static-only holder (all members bound static in the table) that is the single owner of the correlation key literals requestId, the header X-Request-Id and the absent marker UNCORRELATED. Correlation lives in the Reactor Context and in the audit record's correlationId field; no MDC and no context-propagation library is used, so log lines do not carry the id (declared).

methods.semantics: Returns exactly requestId, the Reactor Context key and audit correlation key.
Emits the requestId from the subscriber's Reactor Context; emits UNCORRELATED when the key is absent. Never empty, never errors.
Returns exactly X-Request-Id, the HTTP header carrying the requestId.
